name: Release Readiness Review
description: Collect repository, dependency and CI evidence, assess release risk, then review a sourced release recommendation.
abilities: Produces: repository-state summary, CI evidence ledger, risk assessment and a release recommendation.
Use native structured data and a reviewed step budget without shell interpolation
permissions: Requires: a trusted checkout with Git, Python 3 and npm; a separate CI host with the last completed reports.
Configure: build-machine and ci-machine, /srv/project and /srv/ci/reports, and diagnostics/analyst profiles.
AI analysis uses the selected gateway and profile and may incur model charges.
Import is inert. Resolve targets, review the exact source and save before running.
No deployment, restart, deletion, sending or publication is included.

changes.notes: Explicit failure-stop behavior and default alpha execution contract. Bounded retry for adapter-established safe pre-effect failures on computers; no retry authority from command output.
Full alpha language update: native structured data, explicit budgets and reviewed control flow; no language opt-in.
Initial operational collection, analysis, cross-check and approval workflow.
